intro: Internal migration without a visa or language barrier. Krasnodar, Sochi and Kaliningrad are the most sought-after destinations for relocating from Moscow and St. Petersburg.
climate: From subarctic to subtropical — a wide range of climates to choose from. The south has mild winters; the northwest has damp, cool summers.
mentality: Regional differences are significant: southern cities are more relaxed, northern ones more reserved. A shared culture and language.
visa_note: No visas or permits required between regions. Registration at your place of residence through an MFC or the Gosuslugi portal.
